migration.description: Add the durable monotonic Worker lease used to fence obsolete generations.
migration.release_unit_description: Phase-one preview deployment candidate with cross-process Worker fencing.

durable_state.description: An active row per deployment Worker lease key records the admitted generation, candidate identity and heartbeat timestamps; an orderly stop removes only its matching active row while the preview controller retains the next generation.
durable_state.storage_implementation: PostgreSQL table managed by the embedded Goose migration history.

source_compatibility_range.earlier_state: The missing lease table is treated as an unapplied migration and the candidate is not ready until migration 00002 commits.

ordered_operations.description: Create platform_worker_leases with a positive BIGINT generation and candidate identity columns.

rollout_signals: Goose records migration 00002 before Server or Worker readiness is exposed.
Worker readiness requires a successful durable lease acquisition and heartbeat renewal.

validation: Empty-database startup applies the migration before Worker readiness.
A higher generation replaces the durable lease and an older generation is rejected; an orderly stop releases only the matching active lease identity.
A Worker that loses its lease stops scheduling and a recovered database permits heartbeat and River-client recovery.
The migration is recognized idempotently without rewriting or reversing the deployed row.
